On April 16, Tencent officially released and open-sourced the Hunyuan 3D World Model 2.0 (HY-World 2.0). HY-World 2.0 is a multimodal world model capable of understanding various inputs such as text, images, and videos, automatically generating, reconstructing, and simulating 3D worlds. It supports exporting multi-format 3D assets (Mesh/3DGS/point clouds, etc.) and seamlessly integrates with existing game workflows for rapidly generating game maps and level prototypes. The Hunyuan World Model 2.0 advances AI from "dialogue," "drawing," and "modeling objects" to "creating worlds"—complete worlds encompassing people, objects, and scenes. Unlike Google's Genie 3 and the Hunyuan World Model 1.5, which only generate video files, World Model 2.0 offers greater practicality: it can directly generate editable 3D asset files that can be imported into game development or embodied simulation engines, making them truly playable and usable. Currently, World Model 2.0 is available on the Tencent Hunyuan 3D Creation Engine official website, where users can apply for access. (Application link: https://3d.hunyuan.tencent.com/sceneTo3D)  

Live demo: Input "Generate a medieval dungeon in a Japanese RPG style" to produce a 3D spatial asset.  

Live demo: Input "Generate a cozy picture-book-style wooden cabin."
excerpt_i18n.es: El 16 de abril, Tencent lanzó oficialmente y abrió el código del modelo de mundo 3D Hunyuan 2.0 (HY-World 2.0). HY-World 2.0 es un modelo de mundo multimodal capaz de comprender diferentes tipos de entradas como texto, imágenes y vídeo, generando, reconstruyendo y simulando automáticamente mundos 3D. Además, soporta la exportación de activos 3D en múltiples formatos (Mesh/3DGS/nube de puntos, etc.), permitiendo una integración fluida con flujos de trabajo de juegos existentes para generar rápidamente mapas y prototipos de niveles. El modelo de mundo Hunyuan 2.0 lleva la IA desde "dialogar", "dibujar" y "modelar objetos" hasta "crear mundos", incluyendo personas y objetos.

excerpt_i18n.en: On April 16, Alibaba launched HappyOyster, a world model product capable of real-time construction and interaction. Built on a native multimodal architecture, the model supports multimodal understanding and joint audio-video generation. Currently, the product offers two core capabilities: Wander and Direct, enabling users to build interactive, performable, and explorable AI digital worlds in real time. Additionally, user-generated digital worlds can be fully saved and opened for other users to remix. The product was developed by Alibaba's ATH Innovation Business Unit, the same team behind the previously popular HappyHorse. Compared to the relatively mature architecture and technical paradigms of large language models, world models remain an area of cutting-edge exploration. Alibaba's HappyOyster and Google's Genie3 both belong to the world simulator category. Unlike traditional text-to-video models, which follow a passive process of inputting prompts, waiting for rendering, and receiving the final output, this category employs long-term world evolution modeling. By learning from vast amounts of long video data and diverse control signals such as text, action commands, and image references, the model actively understands spatial, physical, and causal laws, predicts plot and visual evolution, thereby transforming "passive content generation" into "active simulation of world evolution." This provides a key technical pathway for building interactive general-purpose world simulators. Compared to Google's approach, Alibaba's HappyOyster adopts world evolution modeling over longer time spans.
excerpt_i18n.es: El 16 de abril, Alibaba lanzó el modelo de mundo HappyOyster (Ostra Feliz), un producto que permite construir e interactuar en tiempo real. Este modelo se basa en una arquitectura multimodal nativa y admite comprensión multimodal y generación conjunta de audio y video. Actualmente, el producto ofrece dos capacidades principales: Wander (deambular) y Direct (dirigir), permitiendo a los usuarios construir mundos digitales de IA interactivos, interpretables y explorables en tiempo real. Además, los mundos digitales creados por los usuarios no solo pueden guardarse por completo, sino que también pueden compartirse para que otros usuarios los modifiquen. Se informa que el producto fue desarrollado por el equipo de Innovación ATH de Alibaba y pertenece a la misma serie que el popular HappyHorse.

title_i18n.es: Construyendo confianza en la era de la IA con una experiencia de usuario centrada en la privacidad

excerpt_i18n.en: The practice of privacy-led user experience (UX) is a design philosophy that treats transparency around data collection and usage as an integral part of the customer relationship. An undertapped opportunity in digital marketing, privacy-led UX treats user consent not as a tick-box compliance exercise, but rather as the first overture in an ongoing customer relationship.…
excerpt_i18n.zh: 隐私导向的用户体验实践是一种设计理念，它将数据收集与使用的透明度视为客户关系的重要组成部分。这是数字营销中一个尚未充分挖掘的机遇。
excerpt_i18n.es: La práctica de la experiencia de usuario (UX) centrada en la privacidad es una filosofía de diseño que trata la transparencia en la recopilación y uso de datos como parte integral de la relación con el cliente. Una oportunidad subutilizada en el entorno digital.
